children: Snowflake Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $1.55B, improving 35.1% from $1.14B a year earlier, and a narrower net loss of ($191.72M) versus ($298.02M) in the prior-year quarter; diluted loss per share was ($0.55) compared with ($0.89) a year ago.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to Snowflake Inc.”. ³ Reported as “loss per share attributable to Snowflake Inc. common stockholders—basic and diluted”.

Revenue growth was driven by product consumption from existing customers and a 126% net revenue retention rate; product revenue rose about 37% year over year for the three-month period and 35% for the six-month period.
Approximately 97% of revenue came from capacity contracts, with many customers exceeding committed capacity, accelerating consumption and upsell opportunities.

Customer base totaled 14,554, including 828 customers spending more than $1M trailing twelve months and 829 Forbes Global 2000 customers, which together accounted for roughly 41% of six-month revenue.
Operational investments increased in R&D and sales & marketing headcount and in AI infrastructure (GPUs and inference); the company completed acquisitions (Observe, Natoma) to expand AI capabilities.
Snowflake held roughly $4.3B in cash and investments and signaled a positive operating cash flow outlook to support scaling and platform expansion.

title: Snowflake Inc. 2026: Revenue $1.55B, EPS ($0.55) — 10-Q Summary
